meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你的代码库，生成按功能分组的流程图，找出重复的代码或逻辑，并提出一个更简洁的统一架构。最后输出每个新系统的实施计划提示。
howto.when: 当你要求“找到理想路径”、统一重复的系统，或在重构前审查架构时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个项目，找出重复的功能。
say.note: Claude 会开始功能发现和流程图绘制。

say.text: 为支付模块和订单模块生成统一架构方案。
say.note: Claude 会对比两个模块，提出合并建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your codebase, generates feature-grouped flowcharts, identifies duplicated code or logic, and proposes a simpler unified architecture. It outputs implementation plan prompts for each new system.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Analyze this project and find duplicated features.
say_en.note: Claude starts feature discovery and flowcharting.

say_en.text: Propose a unified architecture for the payment and order modules.
say_en.note: Claude compares both modules and suggests consolidation.
